loadingRule: Use this registry only to select a compact designSystem for the app spec. Do not load every UI/UX playbook.

foundations.description: Universal, profile-independent scales every Buildable app builds from. Per-profile color values are emitted by `buildable design`; these are the shared scales plus the token-usage contract the reviewer enforces.

spacingScale.rule: Compose spacing from these steps; avoid arbitrary off-scale pixel values.

typeScale.rule: Establish hierarchy with size and two to three weights, not weight spam.

radiusScale.rule: Pick one control radius and one card radius per app and stay consistent.

elevation.rule: Prefer borders and tonal surfaces over heavy shadows.

motion.easing: ease-out on enter, ease-in on exit
motion.rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and never block interaction on animation.

color.rule: Drive every color from a named theme token; do not hard-code raw hex in components.

accessibility.focusVisible: every interactive control has a visible focus-visible style

tokenUsageContract: Define colors, spacing, radius, and type as theme tokens (Tailwind theme / CSS variables), then reference them by name.
Do not hard-code raw hex colors or scatter arbitrary bracket values (bg-[#0ea5e9], p-[7px]) across components.
Keep one spacing scale, one type scale, and one or two radii across the whole app.
buildable review (design-tokens) warns when components bypass the token system.

palette.intent: neutral surfaces with blue primary actions and status accents

layoutRules: make the core workflow visible in the first viewport
keep filters and primary actions near the list they affect
use stable rows or cards that do not shift when states change
componentRules: include clear create/edit/delete or complete actions
show status chips with text labels, not color alone
include useful empty and filtered-empty states
avoid: marketing hero layout inside the app
decorative cards with no workflow value

palette.intent: quiet neutral base with restrained accent color and semantic status tokens

layoutRules: prioritize sortable lists, summaries, and detail panels over oversized hero sections
keep metrics, filters, and tables aligned to a predictable grid
make comparison and triage possible without opening every item
componentRules: use tables or kanban lanes when they improve scanning
pair every metric with context or delta
make destructive actions secondary and clearly labeled

palette.intent: high-contrast neutral typography with one confident brand accent

typography.mood: crisp marketing sans with readable body copy

layoutRules: make the product or offer obvious in the first viewport
leave a hint of the next section visible on landing pages
use full-width sections instead of nested card sections
componentRules: use concrete product screenshots or real content placeholders
make CTAs visually clear and repeated where useful
include responsive navigation and footer states
profiles.motion: subtle entrance or hover feedback only when it supports comprehension

palette.intent: warm neutral surfaces with clear filters and trust/status accents

typography.scale: compact cards with strong listing titles

layoutRules: make search, filters, results count, and sort controls visible together
support card and detail comparison without losing context
keep inquiry or apply actions obvious but not pushy
componentRules: include filters with active-filter chips
show meaningful listing metadata
include saved, empty, and filtered-empty states

palette.intent: light surfaces, strong primary action, distinct success/warning/error states

typography.scale: large enough for glanceable mobile use

layoutRules: place the main action within thumb reach
keep screens focused on one job at a time
respect safe areas and avoid cramped fixed heights
componentRules: use segmented controls or tabs for simple modes
make tap targets at least 44px
show confirmation, empty, loading, and error states
profiles.motion: native-feeling quick feedback with reduced-motion tolerance

palette.intent: neutral chat surfaces with distinct sent/received message treatments

layoutRules: keep conversation history, composer, and send action always understandable
handle keyboard-safe layout
make empty and loading conversations useful
componentRules: differentiate sent and received messages accessibly
include timestamps or status where relevant
make attachments or extra actions secondary unless requested

palette.intent: inviting neutral base with appetite/service-friendly accents

typography.mood: friendly sans with clear body copy

layoutRules: put key decisions and booking/contact actions near relevant content
make hours, location, pricing, or schedule details scannable
support mobile-first browsing
componentRules: use grouped sections for menu, itinerary, agenda, or intake steps
show validation and confirmation states
include practical details before decorative content

palette.intent: neutral content surfaces with clear contribution and moderation accents

layoutRules: separate creation, browsing, and review workflows clearly
make content hierarchy and metadata easy to scan
include meaningful empty states that suggest the first contribution
componentRules: use forms with validation and success feedback
show content status or category chips
support search or filtering for larger collections
